import os, re, json, glob

base = "/online1/ycsc_chenkh/hitici_07/deepseek-harness/attached_files/task_11"

files = []
for root, dirs, fnames in os.walk(base):

            files.append(os.path.join(root, f))
files.sort()

print("Total text files:", len(files))

# For each file, extract key fields. We'll handle each format.
def extract_fields(path):
    text = open(path, encoding='utf-8', errors='replace').read()
    name = os.path.basename(path)
    result = {'file': name, 'path': path}
    
    # JSON format
    if name.endswith('.json'):
        try:
            data = json.loads(text)
            result['portfolio_key'] = data.get('portfolio_key')
            result['evidence_role'] = data.get('evidence_role')
            result['entity'] = data.get('immutable_entity') or data.get('immutable_entity_key')
            result['referenced_revision'] = data.get('referenced_revision')
            result['current_revision'] = data.get('current_revision')
            result['subject'] = data.get('subject')
            result['body'] = data.get('body')
            result['format'] = 'json'
            return result
        except Exception as e:
            result['error'] = str(e)
            result['format'] = 'json'
            return result
    
    # MD format
    if name.endswith('.md'):
        m = re.search(r'\| Portfolio key \| (\S+) \|', text)
        result['portfolio_key'] = m.group(1) if m else None
        m = re.search(r'\| Evidence role \| (\S+) \|', text)
        result['evidence_role'] = m.group(1) if m else None
        m = re.search(r'\| Immutable entity \| (\S+) \|', text)
        result['entity'] = m.group(1) if m else None
        m = re.search(r'\| Referenced revision \| (\S+) \|', text)
        result['referenced_revision'] = m.group(1) if m else None
        m = re.search(r'\| Current revision \| (\S+) \|', text)
        result['current_revision'] = m.group(1) if m else None
        # body is the "Native record" section text (after "## Native record")
        m = re.search(r'## Native record\s*\n+(.*?)(?:\n## |\Z)', text, re.DOTALL)
        result['body'] = m.group(1).strip() if m else None
        result['format'] = 'md'
        return result
    
    # TXT format
    if name.endswith('.txt'):
        m = re.search(r'PORTFOLIO KEY:\s*(\S+)', text)
        result['portfolio_key'] = m.group(1) if m else None
        m = re.search(r'EVIDENCE ROLE:\s*(\S+)', text)
        result['evidence_role'] = m.group(1) if m else None
        m = re.search(r'IMMUTABLE ENTITY:\s*(\S+)', text)
        result['entity'] = m.group(1) if m else None
        m = re.search(r'REFERENCED REVISION:\s*(\S+)', text)
        result['referenced_revision'] = m.group(1) if m else None
        m = re.search(r'CURRENT REVISION:\s*(\S+)', text)
        result['current_revision'] = m.group(1) if m else None
        # body: after "NATIVE RECORD:" or "BODY:"
        m = re.search(r'(?:NATIVE RECORD|BODY):\s*\n+(.*?)(?:\n\n[A-Z_]+:|\Z)', text, re.DOTALL)
        result['body'] = m.group(1).strip() if m else None
        result['format'] = 'txt'
        return result
    
    # EML format
    if name.endswith('.eml'):
        m = re.search(r'X-Portfolio-Key:\s*(\S+)', text)
        result['portfolio_key'] = m.group(1) if m else None
        m = re.search(r'X-Evidence-Role:\s*(\S+)', text)
        result['evidence_role'] = m.group(1) if m else None
        m = re.search(r'X-Immutable-Entity:\s*(\S+)', text)
        result['entity'] = m.group(1) if m else None
        m = re.search(r'X-Referenced-Revision:\s*(\S+)', text)
        result['referenced_revision'] = m.group(1) if m else None
        m = re.search(r'X-Current-Revision:\s*(\S+)', text)
        result['current_revision'] = m.group(1) if m else None
        result['format'] = 'eml'
        return result
    
    # CSV format - first data row gives portfolio_key and evidence_role
    if name.endswith('.csv'):
        lines = text.strip().split('\n')
        if lines:
            header = lines[0].split(',')
            # find indices
            try:
                pk_idx = header.index('portfolio_key')
                er_idx = header.index('evidence_role')
                ie_idx = header.index('immutable_entity_key')
                rr_idx = header.index('referenced_revision')
                cr_idx = header.index('current_revision')
                body_idx = header.index('body')
                # first metadata row
                for line in lines[1:]:
                    cols = line.split(',')
                    if len(cols) > max(pk_idx, er_idx, ie_idx, rr_idx, cr_idx, body_idx):
                        if cols[3] == 'metadata':
                            result['portfolio_key'] = cols[pk_idx]
                            result['evidence_role'] = cols[er_idx]
                            result['entity'] = cols[ie_idx]
                            result['referenced_revision'] = cols[rr_idx]
                            result['current_revision'] = cols[cr_idx]
                            result['body'] = cols[body_idx]
                            break
            except (ValueError, IndexError) as e:
                result['error'] = str(e)
        result['format'] = 'csv'
        return result
    
    # XML format
    if name.endswith('.xml'):
        m = re.search(r'<portfolio-key>(\S+)</portfolio-key>', text)
        result['portfolio_key'] = m.group(1) if m else None
        m = re.search(r'<evidence-role>(\S+)</evidence-role>', text)
        result['evidence_role'] = m.group(1) if m else None
        m = re.search(r'<entity>(\S+)</entity>', text)
        result['entity'] = m.group(1) if m else None
        m = re.search(r'<referenced-revision>(\S+)</referenced-revision>', text)
        result['referenced_revision'] = m.group(1) if m else None
        m = re.search(r'<current-revision>(\S+)</current-revision>', text)
        result['current_revision'] = m.group(1) if m else None
        result['format'] = 'xml'
        return result
    
    # HTML format
    if name.endswith('.html'):
        m = re.search(r'<dt>Portfolio key</dt><dd>(\S+?)</dd>', text)
        result['portfolio_key'] = m.group(1) if m else None
        m = re.search(r'<dt>Evidence role</dt><dd>(\S+?)</dd>', text)
        result['evidence_role'] = m.group(1) if m else None
        m = re.search(r'<dt>Entity</dt><dd>(\S+?)</dd>', text)
        result['entity'] = m.group(1) if m else None
        m = re.search(r'<dt>Revision</dt><dd>(\S+?)</dd>', text)
        result['current_revision'] = m.group(1) if m else None
        result['format'] = 'html'
        return result
    
    result['format'] = 'unknown'
    return result
